name: dokploy-ops
description: Connect one or more self-hosted Dokploy installations, then run what is deployed on them from the agent — deploy and watch the build to the end, read logs, restart, check domains and health. Adopts a key the machine already has, and keeps several installations apart by name.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy and watch apps on self-hosted Dokploy
interface.longDescription: Connect one or more self-hosted Dokploy installations, then run what is deployed on them from the agent — deploy and watch the build to the end, read logs, restart, check domains and health. Adopts a key the machine already has, and keeps several installations apart by name.
